component.name: QECTOR Decoder Workbench
component.summary: Enterprise Quantum Error Correction (QEC) Decoder Suite with 85-tool MCP Server

description.p: QECTOR Decoder Workbench is a production-grade Quantum Error Correction research environment featuring:

ul.li: High-throughput Rust/PyO3 C++ Extension Core (qector_decoder_v3) for syndrome decoding.
85-Tool Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server operating under strict air-gapped isolation.
Zero-Egress AST Attestation & Runtime EgressGuard socket blocking.
633 unit/integration tests and executive proof verification.
CustomTkinter Multi-tab GUI: Code Explorer, Decoder Lab, Benchmarking, and Diagnostics.

description.p: QECTOR Decoder Workbench v1.0.4 release with complete multi-platform Linux distribution support and zero-egress security attestation.
